Please come ready to decide. —Emeka, Copperworks Elementary PTA"},{"spec_id":"spec_0060","text":"Hey all 🙂 since apparently the async updates thread isn't getting read (no judgment!!), I'm putting a daily standup on the calendar starting Monday, 8:30–9:00, Conf Room C or Teams. All seven of us, please.

Just so we're all on the same page, here's what we'll go through each morning:

1. Ilse Gallo – permit status for the Lakeleaf site (same as what you post in the thread, but out loud this time)
2. Nils Gunawardena – inspection schedule updates
3. Esme Fairweather – public comment log count
4. Ximena Cho – budget line tracking for Lakeleaf
5. Aisha Rasmussen – contractor RFI responses
6. Sofia Sorensen – GIS layer updates
7. Me – anything from the commissioner's office

After that, if there's time, I'd really like us to actually talk through the drainage easement issue at Lakeleaf, which has been sitting unresolved for two weeks now. That one genuinely needs Nils, Ximena and me in a room. Everyone else is welcome to stay, of course.

I know 30 minutes every day is a lot. I'd love to not need it! But here we are. If anyone has a better idea for keeping Pinestone County leadership from asking me things I can't answer, I'm all ears 🙃

Invite coming shortly. Thanks so much, everyone!
– Sana"}]}
